t: This is the chapel of Highgate School, in Haringey. It was designed by the architect Frederick Pepys Cockerell, who lived from 1833 to 1878. Cockerell was the second son of another architect, Charles Robert Cockerell, who admired French architecture and the use of sculpture within buildings. That taste was a major influence on the son. So as you look at the chapel, you're looking at the work of an architect who grew up in a family steeped in design and who looked across the Channel for inspiration.
